design: Three fresh reviewers, identical instructions and dossiers, initial positions then one peer-response round. No reviewer is represented as an original coder.
initial_access: Reviewers were instructed not to read peer outputs before their initial submissions. They reported independent initial review. Shared prior audits and coordinator proposals were visible; this is not a blinded validation experiment.

shared_messages.message: Compact dossiers gained omitted qualifier descriptions and resolved relation objects. All reviewers were informed; original sources and annotations were unchanged.

Coordinator identified the frozen checker filter for this-proposition expectation_recognition before same_actor_only is projected. B incorporated it before freezing; A and C addressed it as an explicit revision in the peer round.
All reviewers received the same digest of the three frozen positions and instructions to respond to peers, retaining source-supported disagreement.

bounded_scope_extension: D10 peer recommendations also selected a literal representation for U23, already present in the not-rushing dossier. Q025a remains a defensible historical alternative; no new source or criterion was introduced.
